Check patient’s distant vision with corrective lenses or contact lenses (if worn) using the LogMAR M&S Smart system. The system is calibrated according to room length. Test the right eye first (by convention) by occluding the left eye. Ask patient to read ALL 5 letters or numbers from left to right (largest characters) starting from the top line. Patient must read ALL the 5 letters from the current line correctly before proceeding to read ALL the letters from the successive lines (E.g Lines 6/48, 6/38, 6/30, etc). Stop the test when patient is unable to read all 5 letters in a line (eg. 6/15). Count the number of letters that patient is able to read from that line (eg. 2 correct letters from 6/15 line). Document the reading as follows: The last line where patient is able to read all 5 letters correctly, both in Snellen & LogMAR (eg. 6/19 (0.5)); The number of correct letters read from the last attempted line (6/15) (eg. +2); Eg. VR 6/19 +2 (0.5) with glasses, if worn.

When the vision is noted to be 6/12 and above, a pinhole should be used to attempt to improve vision. Ask patient to read the last attempted line (eg. 6/15). If patient is able to read all the 5 letters on that line, continue downwards. Stop the test when patient is unable to read all 5 letters in a line (eg. 6/12). Count the number of letters that patient is able to read from that line (eg. 3 correct letters from 6/12 line). Any visual improvement with pinhole would be recorded as follows: Eg. VR 6/19 +2 (0.5); 6/15 +3 (0.4) with PH (with glasses, if worn).

If patient can read partial 6/60 (1.0) line (E.g. 2 correct letters from 6/60 line), use a pinhole to attempt to improve vision. If patient is able read ALL the letters from that line, continue downwards. If patient is still unable to read ALL 5 letters (E.g. 4 correct letters), stop the test and record as follows: E.g. VR 6/60 (read 2 only); => 6/60 (read 4 only) with PH (with glasses, if worn).

If patient is unable to read any letter from the LogMAR 6/60 (1.0) line, use pinhole to attempt to improve vision. If patient is able to read ALL the letters from that line, continue downwards. Stop the test when patient is unable to read ALL 5 letters from that line. Record as follows: E.g VR 6/60 (read none); VR 6/48+2 with PH (with glasses, if worn).

If patient is unable to read any letter or number from 6/60 line with pinhole, proceed to 6/120 with no pinhole. If patient is unable to read from 6/120 line, use pinhole to attempt to improve vision and record as follows: VR: 6/120 (can’t read); 6/120 with PH.

If patient is unable to read from 6/120 (1.3) line with pinhole, proceed to test vision in the order stated below and record the results accordingly: Count Fingers, Hand Movements, Light Perception, No Light Perception.

Check patient’s distance vision with corrective lenses or contact lenses (if worn) using the LogMAR M&S Smart system, ensuring the testing distance is 4m.
Test the right eye first (by convention) by occluding the left eye and ask patient to read all 5 letters or numbers across the top line (largest characters) from right to left.
Patient must read all the 5 letters correctly before proceeding to read all the letters on the successive lines downwards (Lines 6/48, 6/38, 6/30, etc).
Stop the test when patient is unable to read all 5 letters in a line (e.g., 6/15). Count the number of letters that patient is able to read from that line (e.g., 2 correct letters from 6/15 line).

Document the reading as follows: The last line where patient is able to read all 5 letters correctly, both in snellen & LogMAR (e.g., 6/19 (0.5)); The number of correct letters read from the last attempted line (e.g., 6/15) (e.g., +2). Example: VR 6/19 +2 (0.5) with gls.

When patient’s vision is 6/12 & above, use a pinhole to attempt to improve vision. Ask patient to read the last attempted line (e.g., 6/15). If patient can read all letters on that line, continue downwards. Stop when patient cannot read all 5 letters in a line (e.g., 6/12). Count correct letters (e.g., 3 correct letters from 6/12 line). Record any visual improvement with pinhole (e.g., VR 6/19 +2 (0.5), 6/15 +3 (0.4) with PH with gls).

If patient cannot read all 5 letters from the LogMAR 6/60 (1.0) line (e.g., 2 correct letters), use a pinhole to attempt to improve vision. If patient can read all letters on that line, proceed as per step 4.2.9. If patient still cannot read all 5 letters on that line (e.g., 4 correct letters), stop the test and record (e.g., VR 6/60 (read 2 only), 6/60 (read 4 only) with PH).
If patient cannot read any letters from the LogMAR 6/60 (1.0) line, ask patient to read the largest character on the Snellen chart (6/120) and record the results accordingly.
If patient cannot read the largest character on the Snellen chart (6/120), perform as per Snellen VA and record: Count Fingers, Hand Movements, Light Perception, No Light Perception.
